subject: Rename some redis structs to server (#178)
reason: The change only renames internal C struct typedefs (redisFunctionSym, redisSortObject, redisSortOperation) to server-prefixed names and updates their use sites in sort.c and the build-static-symbols.tcl generator. Struct layouts, logic, and all behaviour are identical; it is a pure refactor with no observable effect on commands, replication, persistence, or tooling, so no scenario is needed.
